original_name: 変態おじさんと肉便器にされた私 僕は友達●少ない
source:
The gang dropped their bags in the room.
"It's a good day when we can nab this kind of tasty strange."
Their "strange" they nabbed was a young rural girl.
In these unpopular areas there weren't many good choices, but
a small town was perfect for their predatory style.
An ideal hunting ground for strangers to poach p*ssy.

As her head spun they tied her up.

She sleepily opened her eyes.
"She's coming around, guys. Well, well, well..."
